label: refund_status_summary
expected_reason: 明确单一退款状态查询。

label: refund_status_summary
expected_reason: 只读退款处理状态；不以此保证银行到账。

label: refund_status_summary
expected_reason: 否定新写操作，但明确保留旧退款查询。

text: 嗯，就查这个。

messages.content: 我那笔退款想核实一下。
你是想查询已提交退款的处理状态，对吗？

label: refund_status_summary
expected_reason: 短回复承接唯一只读退款状态目标。

text: 我只想了解平台的退货期限规定。
label: general_qa
expected_reason: 通用退货规则，需要知识查询而非订单工具。

text: 退款按原路退回有哪些通用规则？
label: general_qa
expected_reason: 询问退款方式政策，不查个人退款状态。

text: 食品类商品拆封后还能退吗？请查平台规定。
label: general_qa
expected_reason: 商品类别条件是政策问题，不是商品识别。

text: 退货运费由哪一方承担，有没有公开说明？
label: general_qa
expected_reason: 查询通用运费责任政策。

text: 礼品一起送来的订单，退货时礼品是否也要寄回？先问规则。
label: general_qa
expected_reason: 只查询附赠品退货政策，不执行退货。

text: 识别一下这张照片里的商品是什么型号。
label: product_identification
expected_reason: 仅识别已绑定媒体IMG2468中的商品。

text: 图已经发了，请帮我确认图上的产品名称。
label: product_identification
expected_reason: 已有媒体资产，目标只为商品识别。

text: 这个包装照片对应的是哪款商品？
label: product_identification
expected_reason: 依据照片确定商品，不查库存或实时价格。

text: 我不知道图中设备叫什么，能识别出来吗？
label: product_identification
expected_reason: 已绑定图片的单一识别能力。

text: 嗯，就查这个。

messages.content: 你要查询退款资格还是现在发起退款？

label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: 相同短回复无法消解资格查询与发起退款分支。

text: 好，按这个办。

messages.content: 你确定要立即提交这笔退款申请吗？

label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: 写操作确认不能由只读分类快速路径执行。

text: 别查退款了，我暂时什么都不办。
label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: 取消或停止诉求，不是退款状态查询。

text: 退款到哪一步了？另外帮我取消还没发货的那单。
label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: 退款查询与订单取消两个目标，不能截取只读部分。

text: 先查退款进度，再告诉我这张商品图的型号。
label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: 两项不同能力需全局规划。

text: 不用继续了，谢谢你的耐心。
label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: 自然对话或停止任务，不制造工具调用。

text: 订单 DP2468 今天发货了没有？
label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: 真实订单状态查询不在本冻结三能力中，不能标知识或退款。

text: 这款商品现在还有现货吗？
label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: 实时库存需要领域业务能力，不是知识问答或图片识别。

text: 是的。
label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: 没有原始信息需求，不能仅靠拆封问题猜测知识查询。

text: 把退款换成店铺余额，不要退银行卡。
label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: 修改退款方式是业务变更，不是进度读取。

text: Could you look up where the refund on DP2468 currently stands?

expected_reason: Single read of an existing refund's current status.

label: refund_status_summary
expected_reason: Explicit read objective with new submission excluded.

text: What is the latest recorded status of my refund?
label: refund_status_summary
expected_reason: Bound order fixture supports the existing refund status read.

text: Please check whether that existing refund request is still being processed.
label: refund_status_summary
expected_reason: Read processing status without promising bank settlement.

text: No changes, please. I just need an update on the refund I've already requested.
label: refund_status_summary
expected_reason: Negation applies to changes, not the requested read.

text: Yes, that one please.

messages.content: I would like an update about my refund.
Shall I check the status of your existing refund request?

label: refund_status_summary
expected_reason: Short reply confirms one read-only refund-status objective.

text: Where can I find the standard time limit for returning a purchase?
label: general_qa
expected_reason: General return-window policy, not a personal status lookup.

text: Please check the rules about returning goods with promotional gifts.
label: general_qa
expected_reason: Policy evidence about gifts accompanying returns.

text: Who normally pays postage when an item is returned? I am only asking about your policy.
label: general_qa
expected_reason: General return-postage rule; no return submission.

text: Does your published returns policy exclude opened food products?
label: general_qa
expected_reason: Policy lookup retaining product-category and opened condition.

text: What does the policy say about refunds going back to the original payment method?
label: general_qa
expected_reason: General refund-method rule, not changing an actual refund.

text: Please identify the product model shown in the photo I uploaded.
label: product_identification
expected_reason: Identify the item from bound media IMG2468 only.

text: I have a picture of the packaging; which product is it?
label: product_identification
expected_reason: Photo-based product identification, not stock or price lookup.

text: Can you name the device in this image?
label: product_identification
expected_reason: Single identification goal over the supplied image.

text: Take a look at my uploaded photo and tell me which model I own.
label: product_identification
expected_reason: Bound media supports the product-identification skill.

text: Yes, that one please.

messages.content: Do you want to check eligibility or start a new refund?

label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: The same short reply does not identify which of two materially different goals is intended.

text: All right, go ahead.

messages.content: May I submit the refund request now?

label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: Possible write approval belongs to the governed approval path.

text: Stop looking into the refund; I don't need any action now.
label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: Cancellation or stopping is not a read-only status request.

text: Check my refund and cancel the order that hasn't shipped yet.
label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: Independent read and write goals cannot collapse to one fast-path label.

text: Identify this item from the picture and also check my refund progress.
label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: Two distinct capabilities require full planning.

text: That's everything for now. You've been very helpful.
label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: Social closure should not start a business tool.

text: Has order DP2468 been dispatched today?
label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: Live order state is not a refund status or knowledge-policy query.

text: Is this product available in stock right now?
label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: Live inventory is outside the frozen fast-path capability set.

text: No, not yet.
label: __DEFER__
expected_reason: The original information need is absent; the short answer alone cannot select a safe task.

text: Send my refund to store credit instead of my card.
label: __DEFER__
